guides.title: Quiz 1 Study Guide
guides.description: AI versus machine learning, the three types of learning, classification and regression, k-means, parameters and hyperparameters, accuracy and the confusion matrix, and overfitting and underfitting, and the machine learning process, in the same order as the quiz and flashcards.

guides.title: SUPPLEMENTAL: Full-Course Study Guide (not for Quiz 1)
guides.description: Supplemental, whole-course material for later (final-exam prep). Not the Quiz 1 guide: use the Quiz 1 guide above for the upcoming quiz.

tools.title: Quiz 1 Flashcards
tools.description: 39 flip cards, one per term: the definition on the back, when to use it, and an example. Filter by topic, mark cards as known, and shuffle.

tools.title: Quiz 1 Mastery Loop
tools.description: The Quiz 1 questions as a repeat-until-mastered loop: each must be answered correctly twice in a row and misses come back sooner. Choose the topics and how many questions.

tools.title: Quiz 1 Number Drills
tools.description: Endless calculation practice with new numbers every time: accuracy, confusion matrix terms and overfit versus underfit. Get 5 right in a row to master each drill.

tools.title: SUPPLEMENTAL: Full-Course Flashcards (not for Quiz 1)
tools.description: 46 supplemental cards covering the whole course for later (final-exam prep). Not the Quiz 1 deck.

tools.title: SUPPLEMENTAL: Number Drills (not for Quiz 1)
tools.description: Endless calculation practice with new numbers every time: accuracy, confusion matrix terms, scaling, distance, train/test and k-fold sizes, kNN votes. Get 5 right in a row to master each drill. For later in the course, not the Quiz 1 review.

tools.title: SUPPLEMENTAL: Mastery Loop (not for Quiz 1)
tools.description: The full-course question bank as a repeat-until-mastered loop: every question must be answered correctly twice in a row, misses come back sooner, and it ends only when you have mastered them all. Choose how many questions. Not the Quiz 1 review.

quizzes.title: Quiz 1: Machine Learning Fundamentals
quizzes.description: 120 questions across eight topics, including graph and chart questions, with six short-answer questions and a self-check rubric for each, mirroring the quiz's mix of multiple choice and written answers. Choose which topics and how many questions.

quizzes.title: SUPPLEMENTAL: Full-Course Review (not for Quiz 1)
quizzes.description: 108 questions on the whole course, including feature selection, PCA and LDA, encoding, scaling and regularization. Supplemental practice for later in the course. For the upcoming quiz use Quiz 1: Machine Learning Fundamentals.

guides.title: Quiz 1 Study Guide
guides.description: Tables and keys, indexes and views, SELECT and JOIN, the system catalog and MySQL data types in one place, in the same order as the quiz and flashcards.

tools.title: Quiz 1 Flashcards
tools.description: 42 flip cards, one per term: the definition on the back, when to use it, and example code. Filter by topic, mark cards as known, and shuffle.

tools.title: SQL Playground
tools.description: A real database running in your browser. Write queries against the Harborview Tool Library, including INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE — Reset puts it back.

quizzes.title: Quiz 1: Relational Databases, SQL and MySQL Data Types
quizzes.description: 86 questions on tables, rows and columns, primary and foreign keys, indexes, views, stored procedures and triggers, basic SELECT and JOIN queries (4 you run against the practice database), the system catalog, and choosing MySQL numeric, string and date/time types.

guides.title: Final Review Guide
guides.description: Everything on the final in one place, in the same order as the quiz and flashcards, ending with the mix-ups that cost marks. A practice terminal sits beside it.

guides.title: Linux Commands Study Guide
guides.description: The whole command set in one place: the shell and getting help, the filesystem, redirection and the text toolkit, users and groups, permissions, software, storage, processes and services, and networking and SSH.

exercises.title: Hands-On Lab Exercises
exercises.description: Ten short labs, one per topic, each on its own page with a live terminal beside it — nano included. 104 tasks, every one stating a goal rather than a command. No answers given.

tools.title: Final Flashcards
tools.description: 112 flip cards, one per command or idea on the final review: the definition on the back, when to use it, and example code. Filter by topic, mark cards as known, and shuffle.

tools.title: Practice Terminal
tools.description: A Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 machine running in your browser. Real commands, real permissions, real consequences — sudo, users, packages and services all work, nano opens, and Reset puts the machine back.

quizzes.title: Final Exam Review
quizzes.description: Choose how many questions to take (random, spread evenly across the topics) or run the full 133. Covers navigation, files, permissions, wildcards, monitoring, processes, find and links, pipes and text tools, users and sudo, vi, cron and scripting, with 35 hands-on terminal questions.

quizzes.title: Command Line & Getting Help
quizzes.description: 30 questions on the shell prompt, command syntax, line-editing shortcuts, history, and finding answers in the local documentation with man, apropos and --help.

quizzes.title: Navigating the Filesystem
quizzes.description: 28 questions on the filesystem hierarchy, absolute and relative paths, the shortcuts . .. ~ and -, and every useful flag of ls.

quizzes.title: Managing Files & Shell Expansions
quizzes.description: 35 questions on touch, mkdir, cp, mv, rm and ln, plus the wildcards, brace expansion and quoting the shell applies before a command ever runs.

quizzes.title: Editing, Redirection & Pipes
quizzes.description: 41 questions on vim, the three standard streams, > >> 2> and /dev/null, pipes and tee, and the text toolkit — grep, sed, awk, sort, uniq, cut, tr and wc.

quizzes.title: Managing Users & Groups
quizzes.description: 32 questions on /etc/passwd and /etc/shadow, useradd and usermod, primary and supplementary groups, password aging, and getting superuser access with su and sudo.

quizzes.title: Controlling Access to Files
quizzes.description: 31 questions on reading a long listing, chmod in both octal and symbolic form, chown and chgrp, the umask, and setuid, setgid and the sticky bit.

quizzes.title: Software: RPM, DNF & Flatpak
quizzes.description: 30 questions on querying the RPM database, searching and installing from repositories with dnf, groups and modules, transaction history, and where Flatpak fits.

quizzes.title: Finding Files, Storage & Archives
quizzes.description: 31 questions on find and locate, du and df, lsblk and blkid, mounting and /etc/fstab, and packing things up with tar and gzip.

quizzes.title: Processes, Jobs & Services
quizzes.description: 29 questions on ps and top, signals and kill, foreground and background jobs, and controlling systemd units with systemctl.

quizzes.title: Networking, SSH & the Firewall
quizzes.description: 27 questions on ip and nmcli, name resolution, listening sockets, firewalld, and connecting to other machines with SSH and key-based authentication.

quizzes.title: Comprehensive Review
quizzes.description: 193 questions — the core of every topic in one pass, from the command line through to SSH. The one to sit before an exam.

guides.title: Midterm Study Guide
guides.description: Reference notes on database concepts, the relational model and keys, SQL, ERD and Crow's Foot notation, and normalization.

tools.title: SQL Playground
tools.description: A real database running in your browser. Write queries against the Harborview Tool Library, including INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE — Reset puts it back.

quizzes.title: Final Exam Review
quizzes.description: Choose how many questions to take (random, spread evenly across the topics) or run the full 150. Covers database basics, the DBMS and data models, keys and integrity, normalization, SQL (26 you run against the practice database), transactions, and data warehousing, NoSQL and connectivity.

quizzes.title: Midterm Review
quizzes.description: 78 questions — the exam's own question count, doubled — weighted toward the terms highlighted in the lecture deck and the worked examples from the assignments.

quizzes.title: Extra Practice
quizzes.description: 155 more questions on the same topics, for when you want more reps than the main review gives you.

guides.title: Exam 2 Study Guide
guides.description: Definitions, what each function does, and side-by-side comparisons: NumPy arrays and statistics, pandas Series and DataFrames, merging and indexes, cleaning and imputation, stack/pivot/groupby, and plotting.

tools.title: Exam 2 Flashcards
tools.description: 49 flip cards, one per term on the Exam 2 outline: the definition on the back, when to use it, and example code. Mark cards as known and shuffle.

quizzes.title: Final Exam Review
quizzes.description: Choose how many questions to take (random, spread evenly across the topics) or run the full 215. Comprehensive: statistics, distributions, hypothesis testing, outliers, NumPy, pandas, cleaning, reshaping, linear regression and plotting.

quizzes.title: Exam 2 Review
quizzes.description: 92 questions on every item in the Exam 2 outline - mostly multiple choice, weighted toward definitions and comparisons, with some true/false and matching.

quizzes.title: Extra Practice
quizzes.description: 81 more questions on the same topics, for when you want more reps than the main review gives you.
